2609.30553.title: Rank-Reliable Teacher-Guided Fitness Approximation for Expensive Evolutionary Optimization: A TinyML Architecture Search Study
2609.30553.paper_summary: Expensive evolutionary search does not always need an exact fitness estimate for every candidate. It often needs a reliable answer to a simpler question: which candidate is better? We address this need through Teacher-Guided Learning NSGA-II (TGL-NSGA-II), a low-fidelity framework for constrained Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) neural architecture search. A pretrained teacher organizes samples into strata defined jointly by difficulty and class. Each candidate then undergoes KD-Lite, a short and capped knowledge-distillation procedure on a compact training set, before being scored on a separate stratified evaluation set. This teacher-guided score is fused with a Gaussian-process surrogate to select candidates for full evaluation. For a fixed candidate population, we analyse evaluation variance, score concentration, pairwise rank inversion, expected Kendall-$τ$, first-front identification, and hypervolume perturbation. We also derive a variance-aware fusion weight and a capacity-adaptive distillation rule. On keyword spotting and bird-call classification, the measured Kendall-$τ$ values are 0.74 and 0.62, exceeding the corresponding predicted lower bounds of 0.60 and 0.46. Joint stratification reduces proxy-score variance by 41% relative to random evaluation. Selective teacher mismatch, in contrast, increases differential bias and reduces Kendall-$τ$ to 0.41. Under a constrained evaluation budget, TGL-NSGA-II achieves the largest mean hypervolume and smallest generational distance on keyword spotting, records the lowest mean false-positive rate on BirdCLEF, and runs 2.2x faster than full NSGA-II. These guarantees apply to population-level low-fidelity evaluation and do not establish convergence of the complete evolutionary trajectory.
2609.30553.paper_summary_zh: 昂貴的進化搜尋並不總是需要對每個候選者進行精確的適應度估計。它通常需要對一個更簡單問題的可靠答案：哪個候選者更好？我們通過教師引導學習 NSGA-II (TGL-NSGA-II) 來滿足這一需求，這是一個用於受限的微型機器學習 (TinyML) 神經架構搜尋的低保真框架。預訓練的教師將樣本組織成由難度和類別共同定義的層次。然後，每個候選者都會接受 KD-Lite，一種在緊湊訓練集上進行的短期且受限的知識蒸餾程序，然後在單獨的分層評估集上進行打分。這種教師引導的分數與高斯過程替代模型融合，以選擇進行全面評估的候選者。對於固定的候選者群體，我們分析評估方差、分數集中度、成對排名反轉、預期的 Kendall-$τ$、第一前沿識別和超體積擾動。我們還推導出一個考慮方差的融合權重和一個容量自適應的蒸餾規則。在關鍵字識別和鳥鳴分類中，測得的 Kendall-$τ$ 值分別為 0.74 和 0.62，超過了相應的預測下限 0.60 和 0.46。聯合分層將代理分數方差相對於隨機評估降低了 41%。相比之下，選擇性教師不匹配則增加了差異偏差，並將 Kendall-$τ$ 降低到 0.41。在受限的評估預算下，TGL-NSGA-II 在關鍵字識別上達到了最大的平均超體積和最小的世代距離，在 BirdCLEF 上記錄了最低的平均假陽性率，並且運行速度比完整的 NSGA-II 快 2.2 倍。這些保證適用於群體層級的低保真評估，並不確立完整進化軌跡的收斂性。
